Name: Fine Cloth Camp Skin
Description: A warm and cozy haven.

Name: Winter Star
Description: Protect yourself from the icy winters of Aeternum in a standing tent.

Name: Winter Opulence
Description: Enjoy the view in elegant style with this standing tent.

Name: Herbalist's Home
Description: For the growth and maintenance of a blossoming botanist. Just add water!

Name: Edifice of Eros
Description: Sharing a tent in Aeternum is among one of the most intimate experiences adventurers can experience, and this one is conveniently large for whatever your idea of a romantic night in is.

Name: Fortune Teller's Tent
Description: Whether your specialty is palm-reading or tarot cards, customers will line up at this tent for your predictions.

Name: Full Moon Marquee
Description: Shelter from the cold and rough wilds of Aeternum under the phases of the ever-changing moon.

Name: Wyrm's Rest
Description: Even the most avaricious creature could be comfortable inside this spacious tent.

Name: Reaper's Abode
Description: Aeternum may deny eternal rest, but you can still sleep like the dead within this tent.

Name: Summer Medleyfaire Bivouac
Description: You have everything you need for summertide camping, be it fishing or feasting.

Name: Spiked Sojourn
Description: Rest easy knowing the spikes outside will intimidate most enemies away on sight.

Name: Metalholme
Description: This hardcore hut can withstand even the mightiest bear attacks with its metal framing.

Name: Phoenix Rising
Description: Relax in repose with a tent that springs forth from the ashes of Aeternum.

Name: Home of the Scarab
Description: A place for both scarabs and adventurers to find reprieve from the oppressive heat of Aeternum's deserts.

Name: Final Resting Place
Description: This pyramid-like structure sports a chimney for warmth and if the cycle of death and rebirth is interrupted, it may just be your last night by the fire.

Name: Scarecrow's Refuge
Description: Complete with outstretched arms and a Corrupted skull, this tent offers reprieve from the horrors of Aeternum.

Name: The Spider's Nest
Description: Wrap yourself in a comforting cocoon of spider silk this Nightveil Hallow.

Name: Baalphazu's Hideaway
Description: The carved jack-o-lanterns remind the behemoth of the pumpkinites you've put down in the name of securing Aeternum.

Name: Court of the Dusk Spirits
Description: Nobles and monst'rs alike may conv'rge and conv'rse amongst the spirits and magics of a dusk spirit's pavillion.

Name: Blue Lant'rn Abode
Description: Thyne e'rie lant'rns attracteth flutt'ring spirits, and can draweth one's attention f'r most wondrous lengths, until rest and dreams ov'rtake thee.

Name: Festive Yurt
Description: With gifts guarded by a brave snowman, let the wilds of Aeternum and anyone who passes by know––Convergence is here to stay!

Name: The Winter Gem
Description: Keep warm with a cup of hot drink and take shelter from the elements of an Aeternum winter in this layered tent emblazoned with gleamite.

Name: Stonework Arbor
Description: Rest amongst the elements and safely revel in the splendor of the world around you.

Name: Verdant Pavilion
Description: The very definition of glamping, for those used to the finer things in life.

Name: Vagabond's Respite
Description: Elegant simplicity to shelter you from the elements without blocking out the sounds of nature.

Name: Sovereign's Rest
Description: For when you need a luxurious rest. Doubles as a throne for when you need to be super serious.

Name: Hexed Canopy
Description: For those quick vacations where you just want to curse a few villagers.

Name: Intricate Igloo
Description: The perfect way to keep warm in the snowy north.

Name: The Tower
Description: Even in rest, be ready.

Name: Serene Teahouse

Name: Final Testament
